name: autoflowmate
description: Build safe, reviewable Windows automation (RPA) flows for AutoFlowMate: desktop apps, Tally, Excel, PDFs, Word, e-mail, web pages, OCR, schedules, offline redaction and pseudonymisation. Writes plain JSON flows; validates, dry-runs and runs them when AutoFlowMate is installed on the user's Windows PC.

interface.longDescription: Create, explain and repair reviewable JSON automations for Windows applications, Tally, Excel, PDFs, Word, e-mail and repetitive back-office work, including offline redaction of personal data (PAN, Aadhaar, mobile numbers, names) and reversible pseudonymisation. Flows are plain JSON you can read and edit. With AutoFlowMate installed on a Windows PC they can be validated, dry-run and run locally; elsewhere the flow is written for you to run later. AutoFlowMate is free and open source (MIT).
defaultPrompt: Make a flow that sorts my Downloads folder by file type
Redact PAN and Aadhaar numbers in a folder of PDFs
Export the Tally balance sheet every evening and e-mail it
